meta.title: [Backport][release-474-e] Parallelize Iceberg materialized view base table freshness retrieval
meta.body_summary: Backport of parallel freshness retrieval for Iceberg materialized views from PR #24734 to release-474-e, claiming to reduce refresh time from 560ms to 310ms, but actual commits only contain JVM config changes and no performance code.

perf_labels.notes: Backport PR by Copilot with numerical perf claim from original PR; commits contain only .mvn/ config changes, not the Iceberg parallelism code; closed by maintainer without review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At only 34 lines changed, this is a tiny edit. The changes are limited to .mvn/ configuration files, with no Iceberg connector modifications. The intended performance change was not implemented, explaining the quick closure without merge.

review_details.concern_detail: The PR body describes parallelizing Iceberg freshness retrieval, but the commits contain only JVM config tweaks and a file addition/removal in .mvn/, with no changes to IcebergMetadata.java or any Java files. The agent apparently failed to cherry-pick the actual code changes from the original PR.
review_details.performance_claim: 20 base tables with 10ms avg load time reduces refresh from 560ms to 310ms (~45% improvement).
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer wendigo closed the PR after ~1 hour; kokosing later commented 'Sorry about that!' suggesting the PR was opened by mistake.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cherry-picking commits for a backport requires accurate identification of relevant commits and conflict resolution. The agent failed to include any of the intended performance changes, resulting in an empty PR.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance evidence in the PR; the actual commits do not implement the claimed change.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed by maintainer without review; no follow-up fix.

core_change_summary.description: The PR intended to backport parallel freshness retrieval for Iceberg materialized views but only modified .mvn/jvm.config and added then removed .mvn/jvm.config.original. No Java source files were changed.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes are limited to maven JVM configuration files; no performance-related code was included.
change_trajectory: Third commit: removed .mvn/jvm.config.original and further tweaked .mvn/jvm.config; no Java changes committed.

review_signals.summary: Reminded that a signed CLA is required before merge.
Commented 'Sorry about that!' after the PR was closed, suggesting unintentional opening or closure.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR as a backport of #24734 to release-474-e.
Copilot committed changes only to .mvn/ config files.
PR closed by wendigo after ~1 hour; kokosing apologized post-close.
No human review or performance validation occurred.
